remarks: Stunning brand new construction just minutes from downtown!! - Fantastic 6 bedroom, 6.1 bath colonial boasts 6,500+ sq/ft of living space! - Open floor plan with 9' ceilings and tons of natural light! - Gorgeous kitchen features Thermador appliances, white shaker-style cabinetry, quartz counters, tile backsplash, custom step-in wine locker, and large walk-in pantry! - Great flow for entertaining on the main level between the open kitchen, living room with gas fireplace, and spacious dining room! - Spectacular primary suite with vaulted ceiling, attached sitting / dressing room, 2 walk-in closets, and impressive en-suite bath featuring heated tile floor, rainfall shower head + soaker tub! - 3 additional bedrooms on the 2nd floor - Great 3rd floor offers huge family room + another bedroom with private en-suite bath - Bedroom on the main floor doubles as a great home-office option - Huge walk-out lower level with lots of natural light offers tons of options as additional family / play room, home gym, etc. - Lower level also features a custom wine cellar room + full bath + storage room - Fantastic location offers lots of privacy as the last house on a dead-end street! - Large & private back yard & site plan approved with a pool permitted, ready to go (additional cost) - Hardwood floors and LED lighting throughout - Generac Generator - Another quality home by Andy Frank, a builder with 30+ years of experience!
